dataset.name: VCTK
dataset.selection_rule: speaker-disjoint; complete utterances in [minimum_seconds, segment_seconds]; original duration retained; no truncation or padding
dataset.input_level_protocol: DC removal and RMS normalization to -26 dBFS with peak ceiling 0.95; identical for both datasets; pitch and timing unchanged
dataset.duplicate_recording_rule: VCTK _mic1/_mic2 recordings sharing a source utterance ID are deduplicated before sampling; mic1 is retained deterministically
dataset.statistical_scope: pilot/debug experiment only when probe count < 30; do not use 4-probe results for paper-level significance claims

operational_definitions.H: mean-pooled last hidden state of facebook/hubert-base-ls960
operational_definitions.F: mean-pooled hidden_states[2] of facebook/hubert-base-ls960; this is not called a U-Net
operational_definitions.R_ref_H_ref: speaker-reference centroids computed only from the test speaker's enrollment utterance(s); the protected probe itself is excluded
operational_definitions.C_opp_H_opp: same hardest calibration-speaker centroid selected by maximum WavLM cosine similarity; calibration speakers are disjoint from test speakers
operational_definitions.evaluation_reference: the same held-out enrollment centroid used by the ASV verifier and routing score, preventing train/evaluation reference mismatch
operational_definitions.SQUIM_proxy_DSR: 100 * mean((s_asv < fixed paper ASV threshold 0.25) AND (SQUIM_MOS < calibration-derived SQUIM threshold))
operational_definitions.privacy_utility_success: 100 * mean((s_asv < calibrated ASV threshold) AND (STOI >= calibration-derived utility threshold))
operational_definitions.primary_endpoint: privacy_utility_success; SQUIM proxy DSR is secondary because degrading the protected source conflicts with transparency
operational_definitions.quality_note: SQUIM-MOS is reported by name; it is not NISQA and is never synthetically imputed. Therefore this notebook does not claim to reproduce the paper's NISQA<3.0 DSR exactly.
operational_definitions.L_formant: cosine similarity of the first 45 log-Mel bins, minimized to cause formant distortion
operational_definitions.L_semantic: implemented as 1-cos(F_adv,F_ref) with positive weights 5/20; gradient-equivalent to the paper's -5/-20 times cosine similarity

method_ablation.Random Noise: uniform random perturbation projected to the same sample-wise dynamic bound
method_ablation.Static PGD: fixed Phase-1 loss weights for every iteration; no frequency-domain gradient filter
method_ablation.Dynamic PGD (No U-Shape): the paper's threshold-routed Phase-1/Phase-2 loss weights without a frequency-domain gradient filter
method_ablation.High-Frequency PGD (3.75-8 kHz): fixed-weight PGD whose STFT gradient is zeroed below 3.75 kHz; not ultrasonic at 16 kHz
method_ablation.Proposed (Dynamic + U-Shape): the paper's threshold-routed Phase-1/Phase-2 weights and exact STFT gradient scales: Phase 1 >=2.5 kHz x0.05; Phase 2 <1.4 kHz x1, 1.4-3.75 kHz x0.01, >3.75 kHz x0.15
method_ablation.fairness: all PGD variants use identical iteration count, step size, perturbation bound, sample order, and paired initialization seed

stft.pgd_filter_order: raw loss gradient -> STFT band scaling -> ISTFT -> L-infinity gradient clipping -> alpha-scaled update, matching Equations (12)-(14) and the narrated gradient-clipping loop
stft.terminology: All bands are audible at 16 kHz; the upper band is called high-frequency, not ultrasonic.

calibration.threshold_policy: The fixed 0.24 routing and 0.25 evaluation operating points from the paper are preserved. The speaker-disjoint calibration EER threshold is reported for sensitivity/audit and is not substituted into the method.
